correctness.rationale: Conditioning on magnitudes leaves independent Rademacher signs in any sign-blind ordering. Expanding the unbiased sample variance reduces each local run-change covariance to one adjacent sign product, giving exactly the adjacent-magnitude sum. The covariance-of-conditional-means term is zero. Exact enumeration and rational identities reproduce the theorem, the magnitude-only independence boundary, and the uniform specialization.

value.rationale: The result links a canonical distribution-free symmetry-runs statistic to the canonical centered scale estimator. Its main structural content is the sharp independence/dependence boundary: runs are independent of all magnitude-only statistics, while sample-mean centering alone creates an exact strictly positive coupling governed by adjacent magnitudes. The arbitrary sign-blind-order theorem and the closed uniform specialization make the result more than an isolated covariance calculation.
